provenance: Demonstration inputs and operator-authored observations entered through the local browser. The timed lift results are simulated measurements.

phases.name: Rise
phases.question: What touches, resists or applies force to the tray while it rises?

conditions.answer: The guide is wet after washdown when the tray rises.
conditions.subject: Measure guide resistance
conditions.question: What touches, resists or applies force to the tray while it rises?
conditions.reason: The lift model assumes a frictionless guide. Surface condition can change breakaway and running resistance.
conditions.next_step: Compare dry and affected guides at the same payload and speed. Measure breakaway force and running drag in newtons in each condition.

phases.name: Hold
phases.question: When does the press engage, for how long, and what else acts on the tray during the hold?

conditions.answer: The press timing varies between batches.
conditions.subject: Check press engagement time
conditions.question: When does the press engage, for how long, and what else acts on the tray during the hold?
conditions.reason: The timed lift models axial head engagement. For this demonstration use 0.30 kg and 2.5 N for 250 ms.
conditions.next_step: Compare 500 ms and 1000 ms engagement from lift start, holding force, duration and payload fixed. Inspect arrival and peak hold error.

phases.name: Load the tray
phases.question: Where does the parcel sit and how is it secured before the lift starts?

conditions.answer: An off-center tray can sit against one guide.
conditions.subject: Review eccentric loading
conditions.question: Where does the parcel sit and how is it secured before the lift starts?
conditions.reason: The lift has one vertical degree of freedom and a secured payload. It cannot resolve tray tilt, moments or unequal guide reactions.
conditions.next_step: Measure lateral offset from the guide centerline and tray tilt under load. A simulated comparison needs rotational motion and contact geometry.

phases.name: Release
phases.question: How is the tray released and what changes as the next station takes the load?

conditions.answer: The downstream scanner acknowledgement sometimes arrives late.
conditions.subject: Scanner acknowledgement delay
conditions.question: How is the tray released and what changes as the next station takes the load?
conditions.reason: We do not have synchronized timestamps for the scanner acknowledgement and the tray-release command.
conditions.next_step: Timestamp both signals on a common clock and measure the delay distribution over repeated handoffs.
